versions.localizedDescription: Memory and Soul on the bot's own page, and Bot Settings now owns the identity verbs together (Bot icon, Soul, Memory) instead of hiding two of them behind a long press. Memory shows the two documents the bot carries into every turn, read-only, with their sizes. A Library document can now leave the app: share it on the phone (long press, swipe, or the open document's toolbar) or Save a copy on the Mac.

The bot list's top edge: the CHATS label is gone, the list sits closer to the bar's buttons, and content fades under the bar instead of meeting it with a hard seam. Search conversations now opens as a glass pill instead of bare text on the transcript.

Routines: what a bot runs on its own, with a real pause/resume switch beside each one (read from the host's scheduler, with the error text when a run failed). Three rows on the bot page say what they open: Workspace is now Library, MCP servers is MCP, and Search is Search conversations. Both platforms.
Composer taps no longer touch focus inside the touch — crash fixed.
The composer card is a row again — my regression, fixed.
